cases.question: 2025年华东地区各品类销售额
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, r.region_name, SUM(i.line_amount) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN regions r ON o.region_id = r.region_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' AND r.region_name = '华东' GROUP BY p.category, r.region_name

cases.question: 2025年各地区卖了多少钱
cases.gold_sql: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(i.line_amount) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN regions r ON o.region_id = r.region_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY r.region_name

cases.question: 按品类统计订单数
cases.gold_sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.category

cases.question: 2025年3月已解决工单的平均解决时长
cases.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(t.resolution_hours) FROM support_tickets t WHERE t.created_date >= '2025-03-01' AND t.created_date < '2025-04-01' AND t.status = '已解决'

cases.question: 2025年各客户等级的销售额
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_level, SUM(i.line_amount) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.customer_level
